recorded.prompt:q-filter: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-filter: 'Written as a yes-or-no test, it rules a candidate out by itself, before any number is compared.' CP-SAT is 'out: fails exact_continuous'.

recorded.outcome:q-spread: 'A ratio has no unit, so unlike raw counts it compares across solvers'. Reference: 'X's effort depends less on luck than Y's' when 'the unit-free seed spread is lower'.
recorded.prompt:q-reviewer: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-reviewer: 'This is the real answer to "shouldn't we just buy Gurobi?": not now, and here is exactly when.' Section 5 holds 'the measurable conditions that reopen the decision'.

recorded.prompt:q-filter: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.

gates.says: all 9 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-filter:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-filter:a: 'Notice what the filter did not use: speed.' A candidate failing a requirement 'is out'.
recorded.prompt:q-filter:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-filter:b: The fallback is chosen among candidates that 'passed every requirement'. A failing candidate is out.
recorded.prompt:q-filter:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-filter:c: A failed requirement 'rules a candidate out by itself, before any number is compared'. It is not weighed as evidence.
recorded.prompt:q-spread:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-spread:a: Raw counts do not compare across solvers: 'unlike raw counts it compares across solvers' (5.4.1: 'Never compare one solver's count with another's').
recorded.prompt:q-spread:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-spread:c: The memo 'deliberately does not report... which solver is fastest'. 'X is faster than Y' requires wall time on every repetition, with machine and date.
recorded.prompt:q-spread:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-spread:d: Spread measures dependence on luck, not speed. 'X is faster' is allowed only 'on every repetition, by a stated factor, with machine and date'.
recorded.prompt:q-reviewer:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-reviewer:a: Gurobi in a container works through a token server or WLS. The memo states this 'rather than pretending the option does not exist'.
recorded.prompt:q-reviewer:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-reviewer:b: 5.4.1: 'No current public benchmark ranks Gurobi, CPLEX and Xpress against each other or against HiGHS.'
recorded.prompt:q-reviewer:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-reviewer:d: Gurobi was filtered out by requirements, not by speed. The memo 'deliberately does not report... which solver is fastest', and Gurobi was not in the harness.
